Question: Which statements about trypan blue are correct?

Options:
A. It is converted into a blue pigment in the mitochondria. This only happens in active mitochondria and that is why trypan blue is used as a cell vitality test
B. It stains both dead and living cells blue and is therefore a measure of cell count
C. It stains dead cells blue, but living cells remain colorless
D. It stains living cells blue, but dead cells remain colorless
